title: Gate review prefetch holds a pending gate for offline review in the Desktop runtime
description: Use the same private farm as the browser gate review proof (one pending ready gate on a real package and three active runs on slot repositories) in a private Farmslot Desktop: its own user data, CDP port and connection settings, with its development UI on a private Vite server. A new Desktop profile signs in as an admin principal on its connection page; the first connection prefetches the gate, then the gateway stops and a new document in the same Desktop window opens the gate offline. No GitHub, provider, native or worker CLI execution.

proofTargets.claim: In the Desktop runtime, on the first connection with a pending gate and three active runs, the gate's run.get is the first prefetch read and no more than two runs are prefetched at once.

Right after prefetch and before any connected gate open, a new Desktop document with the gateway stopped renders the gate's details, package diff and evidence images from rows prefetch wrote, and sends no gateway frame.

In the Desktop runtime, judged from the fixture's own blob sizes and bytes, every touched side of at most 1 MiB without NUL bytes is held under its git blob id, and both ids of the over-cap and the binary file are absent.

prove.intent: Observe gate review prefetch and offline review in the real Desktop.

gateReviewPrefetchOrder.intent: The pending gate is read first and at most two runs are in flight.

gateReviewOffline.intent: The gate's details, diff and evidence images render offline.

gateReviewBothSides.intent: Eligible bases are held by id and new sides match their blob ids.
